kapak.alt: The value of serial audiograms in Meniere's

youtube.baslik: Can hearing be good one day and poor the next? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In Meniere's disease, low-frequency hearing fluctuates over time. In an example case, thresholds were 40 to 50 dB during symptoms, recovered two weeks later and worsened again six months later; this is why serial audiograms are valuable.
youtube.kapanis_metni: Follow AIHEAR Audiology Academy for more quick facts.

instagram.kanca: Can hearing be good one day and poor the next?
bilgiler: In Meniere's disease, low-frequency hearing fluctuates.
In the example, thresholds recovered in two weeks, then worsened in six months.
A single audiogram cannot show this fluctuation.

sahneler.alt: One audiogram is not enough: _serial audiograms_ matter.
cumleler: In Meniere's disease, low-frequency hearing fluctuates over time.
Here, low-frequency thresholds were forty to fifty decibels during symptoms.
Two weeks later they recovered; six months later they worsened again.
A single audiogram cannot show this fluctuation.
